pkgmetadata.longdescription: Prebuilt Horcrux manager (API server, web UI, CLI) installed from the image-built tarball; see the ebuild header.

use.flag: Pull app-containers/lxc (with its tools) for the manager's LXC system containers and the Proxmox CT importer
Pull the host tools the SAN storage API drives: open-iscsi, nvme-cli, multipath-tools, lvm2 with lvmlockd/sanlock, sanlock
Install the vulnerability scanner (app-containers/grype-bin) used by Security > Vulnerabilities
